exposure: Training of Community Based Volunteers (CBVs) with modified Information, Education, and Communication (IEC) messages
outcome: Health status of under-five children (diarrhoea, malnutrition, and nutrition status (z-score))
cohort: The study involved 124 Community Based Volunteers (CBVs) and under-five children from Pemba and Gwembe Districts in Zambia.
finding: Training Community Based Volunteers (CBVs) with modified IEC messages significantly improved their knowledge level and led to a downward trend in cases of diarrhoea and malnutrition among under-five children within 9 months.
